aboutPage.title: Transforming Intercity Bus Travel
aboutPage.desc: BusTicket is Ethiopia's digital public transport ticketing platform connecting travelers with verified bus operators for safe, reliable, and convenient cross-country journeys.
aboutPage.missionDesc: To modernize road transport ticketing through accessible technology, transparent schedules, and frictionless seat reservations for all passengers.
aboutPage.securityDesc: Every transport association and private bus operator on our platform is officially licensed and vetted by regional transport authorities.
aboutPage.supportDesc: We empower operators with digital fleet management, real-time ticket validation tools, and comprehensive passenger manifests.
aboutPage.ctaTitle: Are you a registered transport provider?
aboutPage.ctaDesc: Join our growing network of bus companies and associations.

contactPage.title: Contact Customer Support
contactPage.desc: Have questions about tickets, schedules, or operator partnerships? We are here to help.
contactPage.channelsDesc: Reach out to our customer care team 24/7 or visit our station offices.
contactPage.successDesc: We have received your message and will respond shortly.
